parsed.summary: The PR adds the `store_cv_values` parameter to `RidgeClassifierCV`, which resolves the issue but may introduce a behavioral regression risk.

issues.description: The addition of `store_cv_values` may break existing behavior if users rely on the current initialization parameters of `RidgeClassifierCV`.
